**Job Description

**_Do you find Threat Hunting, Threat Intelligence, SIEM and EDR exciting, and do you want to be a deciding factor in IT Security in our internal as well as our customer’s environments? As a Student Assistant you ensure operations can perform their security-related tasks based on guidelines you help define.

_**Tasks and Technologies

**As a Student Assistant you will be a part of Netcompany Operations and our dedicated security team consisting of skilled and committed colleagues. You will take part in defining how Denmark’s most ambitious IT company host solutions for critical Danish infrastructure and large international customers. You will encounter everything from identifying improvements to monitoring of servers and applications, optimising detection mechanisms and response thereof, advising colleagues about alerts as well as adjusting security tools.

You will be a trusted advisor for Netcompany’s delivery and project teams regarding how to solve security-related tasks.

**Your Responsibilities Will Typically Include

**

• Investigating patterns and implementing alerts and visualisations in our SIEM to ensure detection of suspicious events.

• Responding to and follow up on alerts generated by our SIEM and EDR solutions, including adjusting these to ensure precision.

• Configuring integrations between our SIEM and other systems and environments, including Cloud and containers.

• Configuring and monitoring our IDS/IPS solutions.

**About You

**We are looking for a student who can work approximately 16 hours per week. We are flexible during exam periods, but availability is expected in the lead-up to project deadlines and other key milestones. To succeed in this role, you:

• Are in the final year of your bachelor’s degree or have started a master’s degree in engineering, computer science, software, IT, or a similar field.

• Have experience with both Windows and Linux and have knowledge with SIEM or EDR solutions.

• Are highly motivated and eager to develop your skills

• Have full professional proficiency in Danish or English (written and spoken) is a must.

_It is a requirement for the position that you can be approved for PET security clearance.

_**Continue developing with us

**At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We support you in your development and in reaching your goals. You will be included in projects equally with your colleagues and have the chance to take on responsibility from day one.

We offer a strong collegial community where you will work closely with your team who supports you both in task completion and in your development in the role. The close relationship with your colleagues and leader in everyday work helps to ensure the well-being of each employee and gives you concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

**Join an inclusive community

**At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world.

We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

**Send us your application

**Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

_All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

_We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our responsible recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

Job Description:

Student Assistant - Digital Transformation & Solutions (Palantir Foundry / Skywise)

Organization: Product Management - Transformation

Location: Ørestad, Copenhagen

Working Hours: 15-20 hours per week (flexible around lectures and exams)

Start Date: Flexible / As soon as possible

Do you want to combine your university studies with hands-on experience in a leading global aerospace company? Are you eager to master enterprise data platforms, work with cutting-edge digital tooling, and turn business strategy into impactful digital solutions?

At Satair, an Airbus Services Company, we are looking for a motivated Student Assistant to join our Transformation team situated within the Product Management organization. You will be part of a multi-disciplinary group of transformation managers, product specialists, and data professionals driving digitalization across our commercial product portfolio and services.

Working directly inside Airbus Skywise (powered by Palantir Foundry), you will help build data pipelines, expand our business ontology, and craft intuitive tools that empower product managers and business stakeholders to make data-driven decisions on a global scale.

**What The Job Is...

**You will sit at the intersection of business requirements and technical execution, helping turn product strategies, market dynamics, and portfolio needs into scalable digital tools. In this role, you will gain verifiable, enterprise-grade experience with Palantir Foundry-one of the most sought-after platforms in modern data and enterprise architecture.

**Your primary tasks will include:

**

• Building and maintaining data transformation pipelines and ontology logic using SQL, PySpark, and TypeScript within Airbus Skywise

• Designing and expanding object models, properties, and relationships within the Skywise Ontology to reflect core business concepts, product portfolios, and commercial workflows

• Developing intuitive decision-support tools, applications, and interactive interfaces using Foundry Workshop

• Collaborating with transformation leads, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into clear, functional digital solutions

• Assisting with ad-hoc business data analysis, pipeline monitoring, and troubleshooting

**What We Are Looking For

****Core requirements:

**

• Active enrollment in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related quantitative field

• Working proficiency in SQL, Python, and TypeScript

• Solid grasp of relational data structures, data modeling, and business logic

• Strong curiosity and eagerness to learn-no prior experience with Palantir Foundry or Skywise is required; we provide full onboarding and mentorship

• Clear, professional communication skills in English (written and spoken)

**An added advantage (Priority 2):

**

• UI/UX design capabilities: Experience or strong interest in user interface design, visual hierarchy, wireframing, or mapping intuitive user journeys for business applications and decision tools

• Experience with PySpark or large-scale data processing

• Basic version control using Git

• Interest in digital product management, portfolio strategy, or agile transformation

**Location & Working Setup

**

• Location: Our modern office in Ørestad, Copenhagen-located right beside the M1 Metro and regional train lines for an easy commute from DTU, ITU, KU, and CBS.

• Hours: Approximately 15-20 hours per week, planned around your university lecture schedules.

• On-Site & Hybrid Setup: To give you a solid foundation, your onboarding will take place primarily on-site at our Ørestad office so you receive close, daily mentorship in Skywise from senior team members. Once you are comfortable with the platform and workflows, hybrid flexibility will be available.

• Exam Flexibility: We prioritize your academic success and offer full flexibility during university exam periods.

**What We Offer At Satair

**

• Practical Enterprise Experience: Build verifiable, highly marketable skills in Palantir Foundry and the Skywise ecosystem.

• Strategic Business Impact: Work on solutions that directly shape product decisions, portfolio visibility, and digital transformation across an international organization.

• Mentorship & Career Growth: Direct coaching from experienced transformation, product, and data professionals, with potential opportunities for Master’s thesis collaboration or future graduate roles.

• Informal & Inclusive Culture: A flat, international environment where student perspectives are valued and independent initiatives are encouraged.

• Employee Perks: Competitive hourly pay, an outstanding subsidized in-house canteen, social team events, and modern office facilities.

**About Satair, An Airbus Services Company

**Satair is a premier global provider of aftermarket material management and service solutions for the civil aviation industry. As an Airbus company, we operate across 11 international locations with more than 1,800 dedicated employees, keeping commercial fleets flying safely, efficiently, and sustainably.

**Ready to come on board?

**Submit your CV and a brief cover letter (or a summary of relevant projects and coursework) as soon as possible. Applications are evaluated on an ongoing basis.

Satair is committed to creating an inclusive workplace and welcomes applications from candidates of all backgrounds, genders, ages, and perspectives.

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.

**Job Description

**As Accounting Manager at Netcompany Denmark and Netcompany Banking Services, you are responsible for accounting topics such as annual reports, IFRS, tax, VAT and the audit process. You report to the Head of Finance for Denmark and Banking Services and support in leading and developing the team.

Netcompany DK and NBS are part of the wider Netcompany Group. While Group Finance defines the finance framework, standards, and processes, you are responsible for translating these into the local context and supporting the Danish business in making informed financial and strategic decisions.

You will work closely with the local Finance leadership team, Group Finance and your fellow Accounting managers across the Netcompany Group. We are ambitious in how we develop our Finance organisation and actively embrace new technology and ways of working.

• Successfully translate Group Finance Accounting standards and ambitions into effective local processes and ways of working.

We’re looking for a Commercial Enablement Manager to drive commercial readiness and effectiveness across Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, and our partner network. Using data, customer insight and market intelligence, you’ll shape our enablement strategy to strengthen our value proposition, focus on the right opportunities and drive measurable revenue growth.

Reporting to the Director of Revenue Operations (RevOps), you’ll join our newly established Revenue Operations & Commercial Strategy team, alongside Business Intelligence, Marketing Automation & AI, and Product Marketing. Together, we own the commercial revenue engine across Sales and Marketing.

Your focus will be turning insight into action to improve pipeline, conversion, retention and cross-sell. You’ll play a key role in our 2027 priorities, including ABM in priority sectors, growth in DACH and the Nordics, partnerships and portfolio cross-sell.

We are open to on-site, hybrid, and remote working within two time zones of our offices (CET).

**About Us

**Our group brings together three European software brands that help organisations earn and use data with trust: Cookie Information for consent management; Piwik PRO for privacy-by-design analytics and data activation; and Sheltr for reliably finding personal data in internal data sources.

Headquartered in Copenhagen with an office in Wrocław, our team of 180 people have been building trusted data solutions since 2011. We work with companies and marketing teams across various industries that take control of their data model, including some of the most data-sensitive clients in healthcare, finance, energy & utilities, and the public sector. We are proud that our clients rely on us to meet GDPR and EU data residency requirements across EMEA and the US, as this regulatory depth is hard to build and replicate. We believe compliance and performance are not opposites. Consented data, auditable analytics and full visibility of personal data belong to one data journey; together they form a foundation that marketing, IT, legal and the C-level can rely on.

Our journey is to move from a regulation-driven house of brands to one unified company with a clear point of view. We are creating a new category around this complete data journey, and together we are building an enterprise-ready, data-driven revenue engine led by thought leadership. Want to join us on this journey? Keep reading to find out how you can help shape this with us.

The Role

As our Commercial Enablement Manager, you’ll own the commercial enablement strategy and execution, roadmap and performance across Cookie Information, Piwik PRO and Sheltr. Through combining strategic direction with data-driven decision-making, you’ll equip our teams and partners to turn commercial opportunities into results.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Align programmes, content and priorities with commercial objectives, product strategy and brand positioning across all three brands.

• Partner with BI and RevOps to analyse CRM, pipeline, win/loss, sales conversation and customer data, identify performance gaps and measure revenue impact.

• Develop account- and sector-specific playbooks, messaging, competitive positioning, objection handling and customer proof points across the buying and renewal journey.

• Lead our commercial events strategy by setting objectives and target-account strategies for conferences, executive events and partner events, and measuring their impact on pipeline and customer relationships in collaboration with our events agency.

• Turn insights from Sales, CS, customers and partners into actionable improvements for Marketing, Product and RevOps.

• Own partner enablement by shaping partner onboarding, certification, train-the-trainer programmes, co-branded resources and sector initiatives that help agency and reseller partners sell our portfolio independently.

• Support launches, new propositions and priority segments, measuring adoption, knowledge and field effectiveness to continuously improve enablement.

• Equip customer-facing teams and partners to communicate our value in marketing analytics, privacy-first data and compliance.

**About You

**You’re a strategic, data-driven commercial thinker who turns customer insight and business performance into practical action. You understand that effective enablement is about driving measurable improvements, not simply producing more content or training. You’re comfortable setting direction, influencing stakeholders and owning outcomes, while staying close to what customer-facing teams need to succeed.

You bring:

• A commercial and data-driven mindset where you use data to set priorities, identify performance gaps and demonstrate the business impact of your work.

• Customer-centricity with the ability to turn feedback from Sales, Customer Success, customers and partners into improvements in messaging, processes and commercial effectiveness.

• Events expertise through your experiences shaping conferences, executive events or partner events around clear commercial objectives and measurable outcomes.

• Stakeholder leadership through cross-functional team alignment, influence without direct authority and coordination of internal stakeholders and external agencies towards shared goals.

• The ability to simplify complex topics, communicate a compelling value proposition and lead effective presentations and train-the-trainer programmes.

• Fluency in English (C2).

Nice-to-haves:

• Experience with Piwik PRO or other web analytics platforms, such as GA4, Adobe Analytics or Matomo.

• Knowledge of GDPR/ePrivacy, consent management and data governance, or experience selling into regulated sectors such as healthcare, finance, energy and the public sector.

• Experience enabling agency partners in regulated markets, including US healthcare.

• Experience supporting multi-brand portfolios, cross-sell motions and commercial teams across European markets.

• Familiarity with enablement platforms such as Highspot, Seismic or Showpad, and conversation intelligence tools such as Gong.

• Knowledge of German, French or a Nordic language.

What we offer

• A compelling product and market opportunity helping us turn growing demand for privacy-first analytics and trusted data solutions into commercial growth.

• Ownership and impact potential where you can come and build our enablement strategy and shape how we sell across three brands and multiple European markets.

• Strategic breadth by connecting data-driven ABM, sector strategy, partner development, customer engagement and high-impact events.

• A voice in the business working closely with Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, Marketing and RevOps to influence how we go to market.

• Professional development budget, health insurance, and other benefits.

• A positive, informal workplace.

Application process

We’re looking to fill the position as soon as possible and will be inviting candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so don’t hesitate to send your application today.

This is what our recruitment process looks like:

• A brief screening call with our Talent Partner (online, approx. 30 mins)

• An in-depth interview with the hiring manager and a member of the team (online)

• A final interview with the hiring manager, including a live case (online)

This process is subject to change. All applicants who progress to the screening call will be informed of the full process as some stages may be combined and/or in person.

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

At Cookie Information & Piwik PRO we value diversity as a cornerstone of our success. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability. We recognise that certain groups are underrepresented in the tech industry, and we encourage everyone to apply and help us shape a more inclusive workspace.

**Your impact begins here

**As Accounting Controller, you will keep month-end close accurate and on time across a number of countries in Business Area (BA)West, while making the way we work simpler. You will oversee key affiliate finance processes, support Accounting Managers and drive projects that standardise, simplify and digitalise accounting. Your work gives affiliates reliable financial information and the support they need, strengthening Finance across Novo.

**What You’ll Bring

**To succeed in this role, you bring:

• A master’s degree in business, finance, economics or a similar field.

• More than 4 years of relevant experience from finance, consulting or a related environment, including accounting, financial reporting or finance operations.

• A solid understanding of month-end close activities and core finance processes, with knowledge of Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Record-to-Report (R2R) and/or Order-to-Cash (O2C).

• SAP experience.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to carry out structured ad hoc analyses.

• Experience working with stakeholders across countries or business areas.

• A proactive, service-oriented mindset, with strong organisational and communication skills and attention to detail.

• The ability to manage routine activities while contributing to projects and improvement initiatives, and the confidence to raise questions and drive improvements.

**What You’ll Do

**You will combine reliable delivery of day-to-day accounting with active work to improve how accounting runs across Business Area West.

• Perform routine accounting and reporting tasks for a number of countries during month-end close.

• Oversee affiliate finance processes across P2P, R2R and O2C, monitor process performance and follow up on issues to keep delivery timely and accurate.

• Support Accounting Managers with ad hoc analyses, reporting and general accounting questions.

• Guide and support affiliates and relevant Finance stakeholders.

• Participate in and drive projects across Accounting and Finance, identifying opportunities to improve processes, efficiency and collaboration.

• Contribute to standardisation and continuous improvement across the Accounting & Taxation organisation.

You will join the Accounting & Taxation BA West Centre of Excellence (CoE), based in Copenhagen, and report to the Associate Director Accounting & Taxation CoE. The CoE is responsible for Accounting & Taxation for nine affiliates across 11 countries: Denmark & Iceland, Sweden, Norway, Switzerland, the Netherlands, Belgium & Luxembourg, Finland, Ireland and Portugal. It provides expertise, governance and support across accounting, tax, compliance and process excellence.

The team includes Accounting Managers and controllers who work as dedicated finance partners to individual affiliates, while two roles focus on the Business Area as a whole. You will work closely with Accounting Managers, affiliates and Finance stakeholders, and with colleagues in our shared service centre in Bangalore. Together you will keep processes running reliably and speak up early when something needs follow-up.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will work in an international finance environment where your expertise is valued and your voice counts. Combining day-to-day accounting with improvement projects gives you room to build new skills, broaden your view of Finance across several countries and see the difference your ideas make.

You will be supported to perform at your best and trusted to take ownership, in a team that works together to improve how accounting runs.

• Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 570,180.00 to 838,130.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are motivated by delivering high-quality accounting support and making change happen across a complex organisation, apply by 19.11.2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.description:
Do you want to develop cutting-edge software applications for our world-leading products? Looking to use and grow your development skills in a fast-paced and creative environment? If this sounds like an exciting challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

Team Sport Application: Where Trackman goes beyond golf

Trackman products generate extremely accurate measurements using a patented combination of camera and radar, which provide valuable insights for athletes ranging from top worldclass professionals to enthusiastic amateurs, as well as coaches, scouts, analysts and clubs of all levels.

As part of our company's continued expansion, we are looking for a .NET C# backend developer. You will join a department of 45+ skilled developers, and work in our Team Sport Application department, responsible for products used in baseball, softball, American football and football (soccer). You will be part of refinement, planning, implementation, testing and deployment to our customers.

We build applications hosted on distributed Linux servers running Docker, on Microsoft Azure technologies, on mobile devices and customer laptops. You will get to interact with skilled developers working across a range of platforms and apps. We always work with the latest LTS .NET version using C# with web frontends in React.

As part of our development toolkit, our teams actively use AI-assisted tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude to speed up coding, testing, and documentation — letting our developers spend more time on solving interesting problems and less on repetitive tasks.

You will join a team of skilled developers who love what they do and, in a role, where you can have a big impact both on what is being built and how it is built. We value having our developers being part of refinement and you will be deeply involved in finding great solutions from a technical as well as a user perspective together with our Head of Products and UI/UX designers.

Required skills:

• 
3+ years of working with .NET and excellent C# programming skills

• 
Professional usage of an IDE like Visual Studio or Rider

• 
Work in an agile environment with a strong focus on collaboration, knowledge sharing, and clear communication

• 
Good understanding of architectural patterns and software design principles

• 
Good communication skills and a positive and proactive mindset

• 
Experience with Git and Azure Infrastructure

Additional skills (not required, but nice to have):

• 
Experience with using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude)

• 
Experience with Docker and Azure Pipelines

All we ask is that you bring passion, curiosity and structure to our workplace. We are a company of many nationalities. Whether you are from abroad or already living in Denmark, we welcome talented people of any gender, nationality and belief. We think the right mix of people makes for the best culture and product.

At Trackman, we see AI not as a replacement for great developers, but as a tool that makes great developers even more effective — accelerating code reviews, catching bugs earlier, and freeing up time for the creative problem-solving that moves our products forward.

The IT landscape is evolving faster than ever and staying up to date with AI-assisted development is quickly becoming a fundamental part of the software development process.

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

At Bavarian Nordic, we are committed to saving and improving lives by unlocking the power of the immune system. Our commercial product portfolio includes market-leading vaccines against smallpox, mpox, rabies, tick-borne encephalitis, typhoid fever, and cholera.

We excel in R&D innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization, striving to improve people's health and quality of life worldwide, protecting our tomorrow.

We are seeking a Group Compliance Manager who will service as the center of compliance excellence and provide operational and administrative support across our Group Compliance programs.

The role will conduct risk-based third-party due diligence screenings and provide business-line advice to mitigate identified risks, conduct compliance training, support investigation case management, and support data privacy monitoring and follow-up.

About the team

You will join the Legal & Compliance team and work closely with Group Compliance program heads, Regional Legal & Compliance teams, corporate functions, and business stakeholders.

The position is located at our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, and reporting to the Head of Group Compliance Due Diligence Program.

About the role

As Group Compliance Manager, you will support the effective operation of key Group Compliance programs. You will conduct compliance due diligence screenings and provide business-line compliance advice, contribute to internal investigations, conduct compliance training and support the overall execution of training and communication priorities, and support data privacy documentation and reporting.

In this newly established role, you will help translate Group Compliance requirements into practical, well-documented processes and provide reliable support to stakeholders across functions and regions.

Key Responsibilities

• Administer due diligence systems and manage the intake, prioritization, status tracking, and records for third-party due diligence requests

• Independently conduct risk-based due diligence screenings, prepare screening reports, identify risk indicators, and recommend proportionate mitigating actions to the business

• Maintain screening documentation and prepare periodic management reports on anti-corruption, competition law, sanctions and export controls, and data privacy risks

• Support investigation case management, including intake, assignment, coordination, documentation, status tracking, remediation, closure, and reporting

• Contribute to the delivery of Group Compliance training, communications, and read-and-sign campaigns, including completion reporting

• Assist with the establishment and administration of data privacy management systems, templates, registers, assessments, agreements, gap records, and key compliance metrics

What you bring

At Bavarian Nordic, we are driven by purpose, accountability, and integrity. We are looking for a structured and hands-on compliance professional who can manage detailed workflows, conduct sound risk assessments, maintain accurate records, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders across the organization.

You likely bring:

• Master’s degree in law, finance/accounting, business, or a related field

• Minimum 3 years’ in-house corporate compliance experience

• Hands-on experience in due diligence, case management, and compliance training

• Regulated-industry experience is an advantage

You have a sharp eye for details and an analytical mindset. You understand the business and can communicate clearly and persuasively.

Why join Bavarian Nordic?

As we continue to develop our compliance function, you will help strengthen the day-to-day operation, documentation, monitoring, and reporting of our global programs.

In this role, you will:

• Work across key Group Compliance programs in a global, regulated business

• Gain hands-on experience in due diligence, investigations, training, communications, and data privacy

• Be part of a function grounded in professionalism, integrity, accountability, and collaboration

Alongside these opportunities, we offer:

• A collaborative workplace with colleagues across countries and functions

• Professional development opportunities and exposure to the wider business

• Flexible working conditions, pension, health insurance, and bonus opportunities

• A high-quality canteen with a wide selection and take-away options

• Fitness discounts, a massage scheme, and an active staff club offering social and sporting events

Salary

Annual base salary range: DKK 720,000 to 900,000 gross.

At Bavarian Nordic, we are committed to fair and transparent pay. The final base salary within this range will be determined based on the candidate’s relevant experience, qualifications, and competencies, as well as internal pay equity.

Interested?

If you are ready to bring your compliance expertise to a fast-growing global vaccine company, apply now and join Bavarian Nordic in our mission to improve health outcomes and foster sustainable growth.

Please note that for this position, we do not support any relocation packages. Candidates must possess a legal basis to work and reside in Denmark.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

Bavarian Nordic is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

For more information, visit www.bavarian-nordic.com

**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

Experience in process management and project management.

• Oversee daily supply chain operations, including order management, replenishment, inventory planning, and supply planning across international markets

• Act as key interface with CMOs to align on production schedules, execution, and supply priorities

• Serve as key user of ERP systems (e.g., SAP S/4HANA), supporting planning, execution, and data integrity

• Identify, assess, and mitigate supply and capacity risks, developing contingency plans that strengthen business resilience and protect patient supply

• Support audits, inspections, and regulatory compliance activities through proper documentation and process adherence

• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, new product introductions, CMC project activities, and process standardization efforts that improve planning maturity, execution reliability, and scalability

• Contribute to the S&OP process for assigned products through supply planning inputs, risk assessments, and scenario evaluations

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business Administration, Life Sciences, or a related field

• +6 years of experience in supply chain planning, logistics, or a related function

• Experience within biotech, pharmaceutical, or other GxP-regulated industries is preferred

jobs.description:
Shape the future of Global Benefits Management across the Nordics – building on a strong client portfolio, accelerating growth, raising our market profile and developing the next generation of Nordic GBM talent.

The Role

Lead WTW’s Nordic Global Benefits Management business within Integrated & Global Solutions. This high-impact role combines market leadership, business development, client management and people leadership across Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland. As a visible senior representative of WTW, you will build trusted relationships with executive decision-makers and help multinational organisations turn global benefits strategies into action.

This is a market-facing growth role. You will originate, shape and convert significant GBM opportunities across the Nordic region while protecting and expanding WTW’s existing client portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

• Shape the market – Be a recognised voice for GBM across the Nordics and strengthen WTW’s profile with multinational employers, external advisers and internal stakeholders.

• Accelerate growth – Build and convert a sustainable, multi-year Nordic pipeline, winning significant new GBM mandates and creating a stronger platform for long-term growth.

• Lead priority pursuits and client relationships – Shape compelling value propositions, navigate complex commercial discussions and help teams convert major opportunities into long-term mandates. Act as executive sponsor for selected priority clients, protecting renewals, expanding relationships and maintaining continuity from the sales process through implementation and ongoing delivery.

• Connect the best of WTW – Bring together capabilities and people from different parts of WTW to address complex client needs across the Nordics and beyond.

• Ensure excellent delivery – Provide oversight across client engagements, helping teams deliver against agreed objectives, quality standards, budgets and timelines.

• Grow our people – Coach and mentor Nordic GBM colleagues, strengthen commercial capability, support succession planning and develop future leaders.

About you

You are an established senior leader with deep knowledge of the Nordic market, a strong network and a proven record of delivering growth. Strategic and hands-on in equal measure, you build credibility quickly with C-suite executives, international benefits leaders and colleagues at every level.

Experience and capabilities

• 10+ years’ experience advising multinational organisations on global or regional employee benefits programmes and related consulting services.

• A strong record of winning complex engagements, meeting sales and utilisation goals, and building trusted relationships with senior decision-makers across the Nordic market.

• Demonstrated success managing major client relationships, leading cross-country teams and delivering multiple high-quality projects on time and within budget.

• A confident professional presence, with polished written and verbal communication skills.

• Sound judgement, strong problem-solving skills and the flexibility to diagnose issues and move them towards resolution.

• The ability to see the bigger picture, connect capabilities across practices and turn data into clear insights and practical solutions.

• A genuine commitment to coaching, training and mentoring colleagues.

• Confidence using Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint, together with AI-enabled tools.

• A bachelor’s degree.

• Willingness to travel across the Nordic region and internationally as required.

• International work or living experience and foreign-language skills are welcome but not essential.

What we offer

Join a collaborative international team with a strong client portfolio and significant room to grow. You will have the platform to shape WTW’s Nordic GBM strategy, build a high-performing regional business and make a visible contribution to our ambitions. We offer flexible working arrangements and a competitive total rewards package, including performance-related and locally relevant benefits.

About WTW and IGS

WTW combines data, insight and expertise to create solutions across people, risk and capital.

You will join WTW’s Integrated & Global Solutions (IGS) team and be based in the Copenhagen or Stockholm area, with flexibility around location.

IGS brings together more than 350 colleagues across WTW’s global network to address the headquarters needs of multinational clients. We help organisations navigate the business, cultural, linguistic and regulatory complexities of operating across markets.

Equal Opportunity Employer

WTW is committed to equal opportunity and an inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from qualified candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, perspectives and locations.

Combine hands-on software development with team leadership and make a real impact on cybersecurity and global security

Are you an experienced software engineer who thrives on solving complex technical challenges and helping other developers succeed? Do you want to combine hands-on development with team leadership and have a direct influence on the architecture and evolution of mission-critical products?

This is your opportunity to make a difference.

Our client, Arbit Cyber Defence Systems, is growing rapidly and is looking for a dedicated Software Development Team Lead to join its R&D department in Hvidovre, just outside Copenhagen.

In this key role, you will lead a team of software engineers while remaining close to the code, the architecture and the technology. You will take ownership of software releases, Linux systems and development processes, helping ensure that your team delivers robust, high-quality software that meets the highest standards of security and performance.

If you are ready to combine technical depth with people leadership and contribute to protecting critical networks and sensitive information across borders, this could be your next career move.

About Arbit Cyber Defence Systems

Arbit develops high-end network protection solutions for an international customer base, including intelligence agencies, armed forces and national governments. Its certified Cross Domain Solutions, including Data Diodes and TRUST Gateways, enable secure data transfer between networks operating at different security classification levels. With customers operating in some of the world’s most demanding security environments, Arbit plays an important role in protecting sensitive information and securing critical digital infrastructure across national borders.

Arbit’s R&D department brings together two development teams—Release and Project—alongside project management, hardware engineering and quality assurance specialists. You will join a highly skilled, collaborative environment where technical excellence, innovation and reliability are essential.

The role: Technical leadership with real influence

Reporting directly to the CTO, you will lead the Release development team, taking responsibility for its technical direction, delivery and people development. You will work closely with the CTO on technical decisions and development planning, helping translate product ambitions into robust, well-engineered solutions.

You will balance hands-on engineering with leadership, ensuring that your team has the direction, structure and support it needs to succeed.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership & Software Development

• Combine hands-on software development with responsibility for the architecture, design and continuous improvement of Arbit’s core products.

• Develop high-performance software components for unidirectional data transfer, with a strong focus on security, reliability and maintainability.

Release Management & Linux Systems

• Own software releases, ensuring efficient development processes, reliable CI/CD pipelines and delivery of high-quality software on time.

• Oversee Linux systems, make sure that a good infrastructure and hardware/software integration is built.

Team Leadership & Development

• Lead, motivate and develop your team, creating a positive environment where people thrive, grow their skills and deliver their best work.

• Set priorities, drive progress and represent the team within the organisation.

Collaboration & Innovation

• Work closely with the CTO on technical decisions, architecture and development planning.

• Collaborate with Project Development, Quality Assurance, Service Delivery and Product Management to ensure thorough testing, smooth delivery and continued product innovation.

Your background

We are looking for an experienced software engineer with a strong systems mindset and a genuine interest in leading people.

You understand that a single line of code can affect the security, reliability and performance of an entire hardware/software system. You enjoy diving into technical details, but you also know how to create clarity, set direction and bring out the best in a team.

You may already be an experienced Team Lead looking for a role with substantial technical depth—or a senior engineer who is ready to take the next step into formal leadership.

What you bring

• Extensive software engineering experience: At least 10 years of professional software development experience, ideally including the development of a software product from the ground up through to production. Experience with Java and C++ is highly relevant.

• Leadership potential: Experience in team leadership and people management is an advantage. Alternatively, you may have mentored less experienced developers and be ready to take on your first formal leadership role.

• Strong systems understanding: A solid foundation in computer science, software architecture and system design, ideally complemented by knowledge of relevant standards and compliance requirements.

• Linux expertise: Practical experience with Linux system management and a good understanding of system integration, build environments and release infrastructure.

• A structured, proactive approach: You create momentum, establish clear priorities and take ownership of progress and results.

• A collaborative mindset: You communicate clearly, build strong working relationships and enjoy working across disciplines.

• Relevant education: A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or a related field.

• Language skills: Fluency in English is essential. If you are not fluent in Danish, you should have a good understanding of the language.

Security clearance: Due to the nature of Arbit’s customers and products, you must be eligible to obtain and maintain a SECRET (HEMMELIGT) security clearance.

Why join Arbit?

• Make a difference: Develop advanced cybersecurity solutions for international clients and help protect critical networks and sensitive information.

• Shape technology and people: Influence core product development while leading a skilled team of engineers in a collaborative R&D environment.

• Flexibility and benefits: Enjoy flexible working hours, the option to work from home, a pension scheme, healthcare, fitness facilities and team-building activities.

• A close-knit team: Join a growing company with more than 25 employees, an informal culture and a strong team spirit.

More about Arbit Cyber Defence Systems

Founded in 2006, Arbit has established itself as a specialist in advanced cybersecurity solutions for highly sensitive environments. As the need to protect critical networks and information continues to grow, Arbit’s technology plays an increasingly important role.

Arbit is among a small number of companies worldwide whose products have achieved NATO COSMIC TOP SECRET and EU TOP SECRET accreditation.

Learn more at arbitcds.com.

Are you interested in joining Arbit?

Please do not hesitate to apply for the position by sending your CV and a short application. If you have questions, you are most welcome to contact Director Sara Juhl at Bloom via sj@bloom.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

The Opportunity

You will partner with Stakeholders, Product Managers, and Engineers to connect customer needs, business goals, and technical realities, align teams, and carry ideas through to high-quality outcomes.

**

• Work hands-on across problem framing, research, interaction design, prototyping, visual design, validation, and implementation.

• Use AI throughout the design process to expand exploration, accelerate learning, and make ideas tangible faster.

• Partner with stakeholders across teams to bring customer insight, data, business goals, and technical trade-offs into decisions and alignment.

• Identify gaps in customer journeys and shared web patterns, then work with the relevant teams to make practical improvements.

• Create frameworks, prototypes, and reusable guidance, and provide constructive feedback that helps other designers and teams deliver high-quality work.

**What You Could Bring

**
